guides.favoredWhen: Deny her Double Up angles and never all-in; poke wins.

keyTips.text: Never stand near low-health minions. Her Double Up ({cd:21:Q}) bounces off the dying wave into you, so farm from positions off the bounce line.
Never all-in her. Poke from max range and leave — your edge is range she cannot answer, not dueling.
Her setup is Make It Rain ({cd:21:E}) slow into short support trades. Save 90 Caliber Net ({cd:51:E}) to break that chain, and poke hardest while her slow is down.

early-lane.text: Double Up bounces off a dying minion into the champion behind it. Never stand on the bounce line behind low-health minions when she steps up to farm.
Make It Rain slows you for her support's short trades. Save mobility for the slow and back out of the trade while it covers you.

tips.text: Shape the wave so she never gets free bounce angles. When she lines up a Double Up off your dying minions, shove or reposition so no low minion sits between her and you.
She looks for short trades with her support, never alone. Poke her when she is isolated and concede the trade the moment her support walks up.
Keep your net or Flash up in every skirmish. Without disengage ready, her all-in plus her support's chain runs you down before your range matters.
Seed traps on the chokes her support uses to walk up. If they cannot reach the short-trade setup, she is stuck eating poke from outside her reply range.
Fight away from minion waves at objectives. With no dying wave there is no Double Up bounce, and her poke falls off without it.
Turn every poke lead into plates and towers at once. Do not trade kills into her support's short-trade game when the turret is free.

itemization.text: No single item spike decides this lane. Keep buys tempo-positive and keep pressing range — your wins come from lane pressure, not an item break.

guides.favoredWhen: Press your range lead early; an even game is his.

keyTips.text: You out-range him all lane. Keep every trade at max auto and Piltover Peacemaker distance, where he cannot answer with fourth-shot trades.
Never linger at low health. His Curtain Call ({cd:202:R}) finishes low targets, so reset or hold your net to break the line instead of greedying one more wave.
An even lane belongs to him. He outscales hard and is content going 0/0/0, so every even minute is his win — press the lead while your range rules.

early-lane.text: Jhin loads his fourth shot on a minion and holds it to zone you off the wave. Trade while it is spent and give ground while it is held.
Deadly Flourish is a follow-up for support crowd control, not dry poke. A wasted W is your window to walk up.

win-condition.text: A landed Deadly Flourish sets up a guaranteed first Curtain Call shot when fired instantly. Break vision lines and stay mobile once it connects.

tips.text: Race him to level 2 with your support. The first engage usually decides who holds the wave for the next minutes.
Trade while his fourth shot is spent and give ground while he holds it. The loaded shot zones you off the wave even without firing.
Never commit to a trade without 90 Caliber Net ({cd:51:E}) or Flash up. If both are down, concede the wave rather than offering him a kill.
Force fights through your support, not your autos. He is useless once crowd controlled, so call the engage and follow it instead of trading into his range alone.
His Deadly Flourish ({cd:202:W}) only follows support crowd control, never dry poke. When their support misses, that is your window to walk up and poke freely.
Convert the range lead into plates and dragons. Sitting even lets his scaling erase your lane, so every lead must become map pressure.
In fights, hold your net for his root-into-Curtain Call ({cd:202:R}) starter. Dash out the moment support control lands on you so his guaranteed first shot never comes.

itemization.text: There is no item race to win here. Even gold favors him because of his scaling, so base on clean crashes and keep tempo instead of forcing buys for a spike.

keyTips.text: Lean on early range and poke to run the wave and collect tower plates.
At level 6, finish low targets with R from safety, since its channel breaks easily in close fights.
Keep the range edge late and pressure from distance instead of trading front-to-back damage.

tips.text: Fire Q down a line that clears the wave and tags the opponent together.
Spend empowered Headshot autos on champions to tilt trades.
Practice trap spots where opponents walk, using W to lock lane control.
Hold E whenever the enemy can all-in, since an offensive net leaves Caitlyn exposed.
After the first bot tower, rotate mid to press the next outer tower.
Open the map from mid after the first tower and pressure nearby objectives.
Kite backward through fights and save E as the escape from hard engage, since she stays fragile.
Stay near the support and never cross unwarded ground alone where ambushes wait.
At level 9, clear waves faster with maxed Q and keep hammering towers.
Treat extra components as better poke and trades without fixing her weak mid-game survival.
At level 11, execute from a safe angle with the stronger R instead of channeling mid-fight.
Stay with the team late and refuse to get caught alone.
Hit the nearest reachable target and keep moving to hold distance from threats.
Spend E to make space from the frontline rather than stepping up for a risky shot.
At level 16, finish weakened targets with the next R rank from a still-safe window.
Deliver critical-strike autos through positioning and constant kiting once late scaling arrives.
